note: The builds under test. 'baseline' is the STRETCH_BLOCK_MS null path: configure() is never called, so the worklet keeps its {preset:'default'} construction default. That is the byte-identical pre-round-2 code path, which is what the flip is measured against. 'anchor_cheaper' is carried because the spec records it as the KNOWN-WORSE build (loses 6/6 on LSD while scoring ~7 dB BETTER on residual), so it is the sign check on the ranking metrics themselves -- if an arm ever ranks 'cheaper' above 'baseline' on LSD, the instrument is wrong, not the build.
